articles.title: 辨識釣魚郵件與處理資安事件
articles.source_organization: NIST（美國國家標準暨技術研究院）
articles.source_location: What is Phishing?; How to Spot a Phish; What should I do if I think I have been a victim?
articles.source_evidence: 以可信來源偽裝誘使點擊、下載或提交憑證；用既知聯絡方式核實；更改受影響密碼並依事件應變計畫通報。
articles.focus: 偽裝來源 → 誘使行動 → 風險後果 → 處理措施
keywords: incident response plan｜事件應變計畫
articles.english: Phishing emails may appear to come from a trusted vendor while asking recipients to open harmful links or disclose login credentials. Attackers often create a sense of urgency so that users act without checking the request. Staff should therefore verify suspicious messages through known contact details rather than the contact information provided in the message. Opening a malicious attachment may lead to malicious software being installed or sensitive information being stolen. If an account has been compromised, users should change the affected passwords and report the incident according to their organization's incident response plan.
articles.zh_tw: 釣魚郵件可能看似來自可信任的廠商，卻要求收件者開啟有害連結或透露登入憑證。攻擊者經常營造急迫感，使使用者未經核實便採取行動。因此，員工應透過既知的聯絡方式確認可疑訊息，而非使用訊息中提供的聯絡資訊。開啟惡意附件可能導致惡意軟體安裝，或使敏感資訊遭到竊取。若帳號已遭入侵，使用者應更改受影響的密碼，並依所屬機構的事件應變計畫通報事件。

articles.title: 多因素驗證與帳號保護
articles.source_organization: NIST（美國國家標準暨技術研究院）
articles.source_location: What is MFA?; When should I use MFA?
articles.source_evidence: 驗證因素分為所知、所持有及自身特徵，須跨類別；敏感資料帳號應盡可能啟用MFA，兩個密碼不是MFA。此頁已封存，僅取穩定的驗證基礎概念。
articles.focus: 定義概念 → 分類列舉 → 具體例子 → 應用原則
articles.english: Multi-factor authentication requires users to prove their identity with verification factors from at least two different categories. These categories include information users know, items they possess, and their biological characteristics. For example, a login process can require both a password and a code generated by an authenticator app. Entering two different passwords does not meet this requirement because both belong to the same category. Accounts used to access email or other sensitive data should enable this feature whenever it is available to reduce the risk of unauthorized access.
articles.zh_tw: 多因素驗證要求使用者以至少兩種不同類別的驗證因素證明身分。這些類別包括使用者知道的資訊、持有的物品，以及自身的生物特徵。例如，登入程序可以同時要求密碼與驗證器應用程式產生的代碼。輸入兩個不同的密碼不符合這項要求，因為兩者屬於同一類別。只要服務提供此功能，存取電子郵件或其他敏感資料的帳號就應啟用它，以降低未經授權存取的風險。

articles.title: 圖書館管理系統與讀者個資
articles.source_title: Library Privacy Guidelines for Library Management Systems
articles.source_location: Collection & Retention of User Data; Access to Personal Data; Encryption; Notifications & Reports
articles.source_evidence: 僅蒐集營運所需個資、限制員工角色權限、訂定保留及刪除政策、儲存與傳輸加密、通知減少個資。
articles.focus: 系統功能 → 個資風險 → 權限與保存措施
keywords: library management system｜圖書館管理系統
articles.english: A library management system stores patron information and borrowing records, so personal data must be protected carefully. Libraries should collect only the information needed to provide a service or meet a defined operational need. Staff access should be limited to the data required for their duties rather than allowing every employee to view all records. Data retention policies should specify how long records are kept and how they are securely deleted when no longer needed. Personal data should be encrypted both in storage and during transmission, and routine notifications should avoid including unnecessary personal details.
articles.zh_tw: 圖書館管理系統保存讀者資料與借閱紀錄，因此必須審慎保護個人資訊。圖書館應僅蒐集提供服務或滿足明確營運需求所需的資訊。員工存取權限應限於其工作所需的資料，而非允許每位員工查看所有紀錄。資料保留政策應明定紀錄的保存期限，以及不再需要時如何安全刪除。個人資料在儲存與傳輸時都應加密，例行通知也應避免包含不必要的個資。

articles.title: 電子資源廠商與隱私管理
articles.source_location: Agreements, Ownership of User Data; Clear Privacy Policies; User Consent; Data Integrity and Security
articles.source_evidence: 合約限制資料使用、保留與揭露並保留圖書館資料所有權；明確隱私政策、非必要資料蒐集須選擇加入、詢問事件處理方式。
articles.focus: 廠商合作 → 合約要求 → 使用者選擇 → 事件準備
patterns: make clear how ...｜清楚說明如何……
articles.english: Before adopting a vendor's service, a library should review the vendor's privacy and security practices. Vendor agreements should define limits on the use, retention, and disclosure of user data and confirm that the library retains ownership of it. Privacy policies should make clear what information is collected, who can access it, and how long it is stored. Nonessential data collection should be disabled by default so that users can opt in instead of having all collection treated as automatic. Libraries should also ask how vendors handle data breaches and reported vulnerabilities so that responsibilities are clear before problems occur.
articles.zh_tw: 在採用廠商服務之前，圖書館應審查廠商的隱私與資安作法。廠商合約應明定使用者資料的使用、保留與揭露限制，並確認圖書館保有資料所有權。隱私政策應清楚說明蒐集哪些資訊、誰能存取，以及保存多久。非必要的資料蒐集應預設關閉，讓使用者選擇加入，而非將所有資料蒐集視為理所當然。圖書館也應詢問廠商如何處理資料外洩與通報的漏洞，以便在問題發生前釐清責任。

articles.title: 開架、無障礙書架與導引標示
articles.source_title: The Public Library Service: IFLA/UNESCO Guidelines for Development
articles.source_evidence: 館舍應消除使用障礙；資料置於可觸及的開放書架；輪椅可用尺寸、兒童適用家具；館內區域及館藏有清楚標示。2001年歷史指南，非最新建築標準。
articles.focus: 服務目的 → 空間與設備措施 → 具體標示例子
patterns: at a height that ...｜在……的高度
articles.english: Libraries should remove physical barriers so that patrons with different needs can use their collections. Materials should be placed on open shelves at a height that patrons can easily reach. Shelving arrangements should accommodate wheelchair users, while furniture in the children's area should be sized for children. Clear directional signs should identify major service areas, such as the catalog, the reference service desk, and Internet access points. Where needed, libraries should provide signs in Braille or languages used in the community so that more patrons can find their way independently.

articles.english: Reference services use professional expertise in response to patrons' information needs and help them locate resources when they need them. Librarians should help patrons identify authoritative, high-quality sources and refer them to other resources when appropriate. Research guides and frequently asked questions can also provide help on demand and support patrons in addressing future information needs.

articles.english: Before establishing a digital reference service, a library should clarify its goals and identify its target users. Planners should assess available software, funding, and staffing and consider whether the service meets community needs. Libraries should also seek user feedback and revise their initial plans in light of the findings. Staffing arrangements should match the hours when patrons most need help, with clear responsibility for technical support and service quality.

articles.english: Generative AI can produce new content from patterns learned during training rather than simply retrieve stored answers. Large language models (LLMs) generate text using patterns and probabilities, so fluent responses still require careful evaluation. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) draws on external documents or databases when producing a response, helping ground answers in sources. Librarians can help users improve outputs by writing clear prompts and refining instructions through repeated attempts. However, using retrieval tools does not guarantee accurate answers, and professional evaluation remains necessary.

articles.source_title: Tips and Trends: AI Developments and Resources for Academic Librarians
articles.source_location: Overview and Definition; Potential Hurdles; Conclusion
articles.source_evidence: AI可能產生不實資訊（幻覺），涉及學術誠信、偏誤與批判評估；館員以資訊素養專業協助使用者。
articles.focus: 能力定義 → 錯誤風險 → 查核措施 → 誠信
articles.related_exam: AI 與圖書館主題延伸（非歷屆考題）
articles.english: AI literacy involves understanding both the benefits and limitations of AI tools and critically assessing their outputs. Generative systems may produce hallucinations, which are inaccurate or misleading statements that appear convincing. Users should check factual claims and bibliographic references instead of treating fluent language as proof of reliability. Libraries can help users develop critical evaluation skills through instruction and reference services. Academic integrity also requires users to follow institutional policies rather than present AI-generated work as their own independent achievement.
articles.zh_tw: AI 素養包括理解 AI 工具的優點與限制，並能批判性地評估其輸出。生成式系統可能產生幻覺，也就是看似可信卻不正確或具有誤導性的資訊。使用者應查核事實主張與書目引用資料，而非將流暢的文字視為可靠性的證明。圖書館可以透過教學與參考服務協助使用者培養批判性評估能力。學術誠信也要求使用者遵守機構規範，不應把 AI 生成的作品冒充為自己的獨立成果。

articles.english: Before adopting an AI service, libraries should review how it collects, retains, and deletes data. Vendor review should establish whether prompts and search records are used for model training and who can access them. Staff should not enter personally identifiable information or borrowing histories unless the system has been formally approved for that purpose. Data minimization and clear retention limits should be included in local library policies. Human oversight remains essential, and librarians should have the authority to correct or reject unsuitable outputs.
articles.zh_tw: 在採用 AI 服務之前，圖書館應審查它如何蒐集、保存與刪除資料。廠商審查應確認提示詞與搜尋紀錄是否用於模型訓練，以及誰能存取它們。除非系統已正式核准用於該目的，員工不應輸入可識別個人身分的資訊或借閱紀錄。資料最小化與明確的保留期限，應納入圖書館的本地政策。人工監督仍然必要，館員應有權修正或拒絕不合適的輸出。

articles.title: 演算法偏誤、數位落差與館員角色
articles.source_title: Developing a library strategic response to Artificial Intelligence
articles.source_organization: IFLA Artificial Intelligence SIG（AI 特別興趣小組）
articles.source_location: Section 3: Library SWOT; Strategy 3: Promoting AI literacy
articles.source_evidence: AI倫理包含偏誤、隱私、可解釋性；商業服務可擴大數位落差；搜尋及推薦演算法可能限制可見資訊，推廣AI素養延伸館員既有角色。此為工作文件。
articles.focus: 技術影響 → 公平性風險 → 素養教學 → 專業角色
articles.related_exam: AI 與圖書館主題延伸（非歷屆考題）
articles.english: AI-powered search and recommendation systems can influence what information is displayed and what is overlooked. Librarians should therefore consider algorithmic bias a matter of service quality rather than a technical issue alone. Commercial subscription tools may further widen the digital divide, particularly when access depends on the ability to pay. AI literacy instruction should address privacy, explainability, and the ways algorithms shape information choices. This educational role builds on libraries' existing commitment to information literacy and equitable access to knowledge.
articles.zh_tw: AI 驅動的搜尋與推薦系統可能影響哪些資訊被顯示，以及哪些資訊遭到忽略。因此，館員應把演算法偏誤視為服務品質問題，而非僅是技術議題。商業訂閱工具可能進一步擴大數位落差，尤其當存取取決於付費能力時。AI 素養教學應處理隱私、可解釋性，以及演算法如何塑造資訊選擇等問題。這個教育角色建立在圖書館對資訊素養與公平取得知識的既有承諾之上。

articles.source_evidence: 著作權影響模型訓練及使用；IFLA倡議合法取得內容的文字資料探勘例外、廣泛資料集及適當授權；倫理問題不能只靠著作權處理。此為政策立場，非現行通用法律。
keywords: text and data mining｜文字與資料探勘
articles.focus: 法律影響 → 組織倡議 → 資料多樣性 → 倫理

articles.english: Copyright rules can affect how AI models are trained and how libraries use the resulting tools. IFLA advocates limitations and exceptions that permit text and data mining of content acquired or accessed legitimately. It also emphasizes that a broad range of training data can help reduce bias and error. Libraries can prepare collections for AI use through appropriate licensing while considering the needs of research and education. However, ethical problems require a wider response rather than relying only on copyright restrictions.
articles.zh_tw: 著作權規範可能影響 AI 模型如何訓練，以及圖書館如何運用相關工具。IFLA 倡議能容許對合法取得的內容進行文字與資料探勘的限制與例外。它也強調廣泛的訓練資料有助於降低偏誤與錯誤。圖書館可以透過適當授權讓館藏更適合供 AI 使用，同時考量研究與教育的需求。然而，倫理問題需要更廣泛的回應，而非只依賴著作權限制。
